# Bitropix

> Bitropix is an IT services and digital marketing agency headquartered in Noida, India. We design, build, and grow digital products for startups and enterprises across India, the US, UK, UAE, and Australia. Core capabilities: web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, SEO and digital marketing, cloud migrations, and digital transformation consulting.

- Website: https://www.bitropix.com
- Email: info@bitropix.com
- Phone: +91-9318454571
- Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Founded: 2023

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.bitropix.com/services#web): Custom websites, web applications, and PWAs built on React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.bitropix.com/services#mobile): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native and Flutter.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.bitropix.com/services#design): User research, prototyping, and design systems in Figma.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://www.bitropix.com/services#marketing): Technical SEO, content marketing, paid media, social media, and analytics.
- [Cloud Migration](https://www.bitropix.com/services#cloud): AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud architecture, migration, and DevOps.
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.bitropix.com/services#digital-transformation): Strategy and roadmap consulting for legacy modernization.
- [Embedded Systems](https://www.bitropix.com/services#embedded): Hardware-firmware integration and low-level systems engineering.
- [IoT Solutions](https://www.bitropix.com/services#iot): Connected device fleets, telemetry, and edge analytics.
